groups.name: controls

method.rendering: Only the owned registry payloads were mounted in a standalone/export-style host with the local Inter fonts and resolved bundled assets. The complete 399-entry application was not booted.
method.inventory: DOM SVG/glyph/CSS/pseudo candidates were combined with per-entry source and visual review. Manually added classless menu bars, single-letter action glyphs, window dots, all magnetic/card-front symbols, the terminal-link dot, tracking/route dots, price triangles and conditional deployment icons. Numeric signs, ellipses, literal code/ASCII, graph ports, physical dial markers and artwork were classified explicitly rather than treated as centering errors.
method.visual: Every entry was inspected in both rest and group-activated screenshots at both widths. Dedicated captures inspected actual expanded/conditional UI states. Geometry is live DOM layout/text-range evidence; it is not raster optical measurement. Deliberate optical offsets and motion are noted per entry.
method.focusedOperations: Real pointer click and mouse drag plus keyboard Enter/Escape/arrows/full Konami sequence were used in dedicated checks. No synthetic pointermove was reported as a completed drag.
